title: ID0367318-DC/Si-D/DE[170002779] - Display ist defekt
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
There is a defect in the display or the glass pane on our charging station. After inspection, the defect is apparently not on the outer protective pane, but underneath it.
Root cause:
Broken?
Solution:
Replace the HMI
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
No
